notes.title: Final content update
notes.content: 5 new girls, it's also now moddable. Plenty of quality of life updates. Thanks for the fish. Tired.

notes.title: Love Rocket 0.2.666 Small update with 5 girls, upcoming price hike on release
notes.content:
Rest of the season 2 girls are here along with a few minor fixes. MG, Tama, Clara, The Ensign and a mystery girl are now available to play and unlock. The last clothing item effect bg and voice reacts have been deprecated.

The price will go up to 6.99 after valentines day upon release and the first batch of the last season releasing.

notes.title: Love Rocket 0.1.666 end of season 1
notes.content:
- The manual is here
- Bugs with character portraits fixed.
- Multiple (over 6) lottery tickets and coins now all come instantly
- Green lights turn off if there are no missiles
- Fixed multiple missing portrait and dialogue errors.

I will put all of the audience members for season 1 when season 2 releases. When it's time, the price will go up with 2 bucks! So post S2 price will be 5.99
